title: Signing of US–Venezuela long‑term oil access agreement
rationale: Multiple reports say US nears deal and will take control / invest (Aug 28-29 headlines).

title: Formal approval of Pentagon's 35% stake
rationale: WSJ and other reports: Pentagon to take 35% stake; headlines describe plan and criticism (Aug 30).

title: Chevron deal closing and project expansion
rationale: Reports say Chevron to complete deal, migrate and expand projects; other US firms near investments (Aug 29 headlines).

title: Escalation of domestic political backlash
rationale: Multiple headlines say the oil deal is denounced by both sides and draws criticism (Aug 30).

title: Ratification of 25‑year access contract
rationale: Venezuelan interim president said the US energy deal will last 25 years (Reuters, Aug 30).

title: US congressional or legal challenge to the deal
rationale: Deal provokes criticism and is politically controversial in US; legal/legislative challenges likely (multiple headlines).

title: Commencement of Venezuelan oil shipments to US
rationale: Statements about using Venezuelan oil to refill US reserves and US taking control imply imminent shipments (Aug 28-30 headlines).

title: Start of SPR refill using Venezuelan oil
rationale: Trump stated US will refill the SPR using Venezuelan oil (Aug 30 headlines).
